knowledge.title: ML numerics: loss becomes NaN with large logits — softmax overflows; subtract max(x) first
knowledge.solutionUnderTest: 1) z = x - max(x)  2) e = exp(z)  3) softmax = e / sum(e). Never implement softmax without the max shift. In frameworks use the fused op which does this internally: torch.softmax / F.log_softmax, tf.nn.softmax, scipy.special.softmax. Related: never compute cross-entropy as log(softmax(x)) — use the log-sum-exp form (companion record in this library).

testCommands.command:
python3 -c 'import math,sys
x=[1000.0,1001.0];m=max(x)
t=sum(math.exp(v-m) for v in x);s=[math.exp(v-m)/t for v in x]
ok=all(map(math.isfinite,s)) and abs(sum(s)-1)<1e-12
print("stable softmax:",s)
print("STABLE" if ok else "UNSTABLE")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'
